item.title: Football: Morocco, Senegal Reach CAF Africa Cup Of Nations Semifinals
item.description: At Prince Moulay Abdellah Stadium: Host Morocco won over Cameroon 2-0, and Senegal defeated Mali 1-0 on Friday to book the first two tickets to the semifinals in the CAF Africa Cup of Nations football tournament.

item.title: WPL 2026: De Klerk Pulls Off A Heist As RCB Steal Thrilling Three-wicket Win Over MI
item.description: Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) pulled off a dramatic three-wicket win over defending champions Mumbai Indians (MI) in the 2206 Women’s Premier League (WPL) opener at the DY Patil Stadium on Friday.

item.title: Malaysia Open: Can’t Expect Match To Be Easy Even When You’re Leading, Says Sindhu After Semis Exit
item.description: Indira Gandhi Sports Complex: P.V. Sindhu acknowledged that she let the game slip away after missing an opportunity to take the lead against her Chinese opponent, Wang Zhiyi, in the women’s singles semifinal of the Malaysia Open. Her impressive run at the tournament came to an end on Saturday after a straight-games defeat to the World No. 2 at the Axiata Arena, Bukit Jalil.

item.title: UP Warriroz Women vs Gujarat Giants Women, Match 2, WPL 2026, Who will win today UPW-W vs GG-W match?
item.description: Gujarat Giants Women will take on UP Warriorz Women in the second game of the WPL 2026 on Saturday.

item.title: Sabalenka Storms Into Third Straight Brisbane International Final With Win Over Muchova
item.description: World No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka snapped her three-match losing run against Karolina Muchova with a confident 6-3, 6-4 victory in the Brisbane International semifinal on Saturday, booking her place in the final and extending her unbeaten start to the 2026 season.

item.title: Mumbai Indians Women vs Delhi Capitals Women, Match 3, WPL 2026, Who will win today MI-W vs DC-W match?
item.description: Mumbai Indians will take on Delhi Capitals in the third game of the WPL 2026 on Saturday.

item.title: HD Kumaraswamy Thanks Mansukh Mandaviya For Sanctioning Multi-purpose Sports Facility In K'taka
item.description: Sports Mansukh Mandaviya: Union Minister for Heavy Industries and Steel H.D. Kumaraswamy on Saturday thanked Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Mansukh Mandaviya for sanctioning Rs 14 crore for the construction of a multi-purpose sports facility in Karnataka's Mandya district under the 'Khelo India Scheme'.

item.title: WPL 2026: Beating Teams Led By Indian Captains Will Be Extra Motivation, Says Ashleigh Gardner Ahead Of Giants' Opener
item.description: DY Patil Stadium: While heaping praise on the Indian women's team for its recent upsurge leading to the sensational victory in the 50-over World Cup, Australian star Ashleigh Gardner, the captain of Gujarat Giants, said beating teams led by Indian players is extra motivation for her because of the popularity they enjoy at home.

item.title: Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue Inaugurated At Bharat Mandapam; Mandaviya, Ajit Doval Address Youths
item.description: Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue: The Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue was inaugurated on Friday at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, by Union Minister of Youth Affairs & Sports and Labour & Employment, Mansukh Mandaviya, along with National Security Advisor Ajit Doval, marking a significant step towards empowering India’s youth to actively participate in nation-building.

item.title: WPL 2026: Pooja Vastrakar Out For Two Weeks With Hamstring Injury, Informs RCB Coach Malolan Rangarajan
item.description: Royal Challengers Bengaluru: Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) head coach Malolan Rangarajan has revealed that Pooja Vastrakar has sustained a hamstring injury, because of which she was unavailable for selection for the team’s opening game of the Women’s Premier League (WPL) 2026 against the Mumbai Indians (MI) on Friday, and also stated that the pacer will be out for at least two more weeks.
